title: ReelSaid — Instagram Reels Transcript API
description: Transcribe public Instagram Reels to text with Whisper Large-v3. Get original-language transcripts, opening hooks, word timestamps, SRT and WebVTT, and post metadata. Send one Reel to the live API or process links, profiles, and datasets in bulk.
seoDescription: Transcribe Instagram Reels and profiles with Whisper Large-v3. Get timed text, word timestamps, opening hooks, SRT and WebVTT, and post metadata.
